Broccoli Cottage Bake
By: Mindy
Published: Wednesday, February 24, 2010 - 8:32am

Ingredients




16 ounces cottage cheese
16 ounces frozen broccoli thawed & chopped (I used all broc)
ounce (or 10  broccoli & 7 oz red peppers - it's up to you!)
1 cup shredded sharp cheddar
4 eggs, beaten
3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese
3 tablespoons dry bread crumbs

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350f 2 Mix all ingredients until well blended 3 Pour into 9" pie plate (spray plate with cooking spray) 4 Bake 45 minutes or until center is set 5 Let sit 10 minutes & serve

About


We served this with melon & toast for dinner. It was really good & easy and could also be a breakfast food.
